def runsolve(di_):
    H,W=len(di_),len(di_[0]); bg=max(set(sum(di_,[])),key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in di_))
    cl=comps_of(di_,bg); fams=defaultdict(list)
    for cc in cl: fams[normc(cc[1])].append(cc)
    fam=[(kk,vv) for kk,vv in fams.items() if len(vv)>1]
    kk,vv=max(fam,key=lambda t:len(t[0]))
    uniqs=[p for p in cl if len([q for q in cl if q[0]==p[0]])==1]
    mk=max(uniqs,key=lambda u:len(u[1]))
    def d(u): return mindist(u[1],mk[1])
    inter=[u for u in vv if not any(y==0 or y==H-1 or x==0 or x==W-1 for y,x in u[1])]
    if inter:
        far=max(inter,key=d)
    else:
        far=max(vv,key=d)
    out=[r[:] for r in di_]
    for y,x in far[1]: out[y][x]=mk[0]
    return out

def mind(u,v): return min(abs(a-b)+abs(c-d) for (a,c) in u for (b,d) in v)
def norm2(c):
    y,x=min(c); return tuple(sorted((a-y,b-x) for a,b in c))
def solve(ti_):
    bg=max(set(sum(ti_,[])),key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in ti_))
    cl=comps_of(ti_,bg)
    fam=defaultdict(list)
    for ci,c in enumerate(cl):
        fam[norm2(c)].append(ci)
    cnts=Counter([ti_[min(cl[ci])[0]][min(cl[ci])[1]] for ci in range(len(cl))])
    mkc=max((ci for ci in range(len(cl)) if cnts[ti_[min(cl[ci])[0]][min(cl[ci])[1]]]==1 and len(cl[ci])>1),key=lambda ci:len(cl[ci]))
    out=[r[:] for r in ti_]
    pairs=[(k,v) for k,v in fam.items() if len(v)==2]
    # select the largest-size pair (demo2: sz3 beat sz1; demo3: sz4 beat sz1)
    k,bestv=max(pairs,key=lambda p:len(p[0]))
    c1,c2=cl[bestv[0]],cl[bestv[1]]
    d1,d2=mind(c1,cl[mkc]),mind(c2,cl[mkc])
    tgt=c1 if d1>d2 else c2
    mc=ti_[min(cl[mkc])[0]][min(cl[mkc])[1]]
    for y,x in tgt: out[y][x]=mc
    return out
for i in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    print(i,solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
import json; o=solve(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(o))
